# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RSI_MEANREVERT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price deviates significantly below VWAP while RSI shows oversold conditions, mean-reversion to VWAP offers an edge. This occurs during short-term panic selling where panic drives price below fair value (VWAP) and momentum oscillators indicate exhaustion, creating a statistical reversion opportunity.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If price closes >1 ATR below VWAP AND RSI(14) < 30 on the same bar, go long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Chart-stop at a close below VWAP (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1R (risk-reward 1:1), runner trail 20% off high-water mark. Regime hint: Works best when VIX > 18 (elevated volatility) to increase mean-reversion propensity; avoid strong trending days where the ribbon is bullish and price stays above VWAP for >3 consecutive bars.
